scope: Content interpretation, colour, functions, forms, optional content and page transforms checked against the local ISO 32000-2:2020 sponsored EC3 text. Implemented transparency in clause 11, analytic/mesh shadings, shading and tiling patterns in 8.7, annotation appearances, generated link/square/note/file-attachment shapes and view flags in 12.5 and continuous-tone halftone bypass in 10.6 are covered by independent fixtures. Exact-area bytes, Bradford adaptation, sRGB output and rounding are project policy. ICC source admission, Gray/RGB matrix/TRC and forward mft1/mft2/mAB processing are checked against locally supplied ICC.1:2010 (v4.3); legacy v2 transform encodings are covered, but v2-specific metadata rules await a primary v2 text.

requirements.rule: Supported embedded source profiles use forward processing, never silent Alternate substitution. Gray TRCs scale PCS D50 XYZ or L*=100, not media white (ICC F.2); RGB uses the column matrix and per-channel TRCs (F.3). Sampled forward curves may be nonmonotonic and matrices need not be invertible. Parametric outputs clip, including positive overflow; threshold arithmetic preserves the nonnegative power domain. ICC Table 34 count-one gamma is two-byte unsigned 8.8 per 4.9; Table 65 is interpreted with complementary branches and the separate e offset for type 4 because its printed formulas conflict with its parameter list. Source values clip to ICC Range before Alternate, including later-version fallback; Alternate structure is validated even when unused. Bradford D50-to-D65 adaptation, sRGB output encoding, gamut clipping and final rounding are project policy.

requirements.rule: Mesh records decode coordinates and components, honour byte padding and reuse preceding edges. Triangles interpolate barycentrically; patches interpolate corner components bilinearly in their bicubic parameter space. Functions run after interpolation. Later patches take precedence; folds select largest v then u. Pixel-centre sampling, numeric root tolerance and byte rounding are project policies. Patch inversion uses a 2^-24 parameter subdivision floor and a 1e-9 tie tolerance for coincident v roots; these are project numeric policies.

requirements.rule: ICC.1:2010 v4 profiles validate BCD/version reserved bytes, Gregorian dates, permitted source class/colour-space/PCS, attributes, intent, D50 illuminant, MD5 ProfileID and reserved bytes; required tags depend on profile class/model. Tag bodies are tightly packed, aligned and zero-padded, with exact shared bodies allowed. XYZ records are complete and nonnegative, reserved type fields and curve extents are exact, and chad is a signed sf32 invertible 3-by-3 matrix. These v4 metadata rules are not imposed on legacy v2 profiles. All table products, extents, allocations and cumulative retained profile storage are bounded before use.
requirements.status: implemented; ICC.1:2010 primary text verified

requirements.rule: Forward mft2 uses input tables, CLUT and output tables; its source-non-XYZ matrix must be identity. Forward mft1 uses 256-sample input/output tables and Lab PCS. mAB accepts B, M+matrix+B, A+CLUT+B and A+CLUT+M+matrix+B, including unequal grid sizes and 8/16-bit CLUTs. PCSXYZ uses unsigned 1.15; mft2 uses legacy FF00 Lab white in both v2 and v4, while mft1 and mAB use modern Lab encodings. Source Lab values use L* 0–100 and a*/b* -128–127 before normalization. Multilinear CLUT interpolation is project policy; two-point axes are linear as ICC requires. Evaluation uses at most 16 corners for PDF source profiles. Inverse mBA selected as a forward transform fails explicitly; optional BToA tags are ignored. LUT8 XYZ PCS has no specified encoding and remains explicit Unsupported.
requirements.status: implemented; ICC.1:2010 primary text verified
requirements.gaps: LUT8 XYZ PCS is implementation-specific and unsupported; inverse BToA processing; multiProcessElementsType DToB transforms. Image default Decode and Indexed-image palettes must use ICC component ranges in the image painting layer.

external_primary_review.reason: Legacy Lab belongs to mft2, irrespective of profile major version. All legal mAB stage combinations and per-stage clipping are covered.

requirements.rule: PDF ri and ExtGState RI, saved/restored with graphics state, choose the designated source AToB intent transform, then AToB0, then matrix/TRCs. An unrelated AToB2 does not block relative matrix processing. Unsupported DToB elements may be bypassed under ICC 8.10.2(a). PDF ignores profile-header intent and inverse BToA tags. Absolute colorimetry uses the relative transform and scales by media-white/PCS-white. Unknown PDF intents fall back to RelativeColorimetric. The RGB output target and its adaptation remain project policy.
requirements.status: implemented; ICC.1:2010 primary text verified
requirements.gaps: Perceptual output-side gamut mapping and black-point compensation; unsupported DToB element types use the permitted fallback.

requirements.rule: Strict mode rejects each repair with its stable content tag; repair mode reports it before continuing. Numeric SC/sc may select a matching non-pattern special or ICC colour, undefined paths paint nothing and discard pending clips, clipping is deferred past further construction, and excess palette bytes are ignored. Missing required OCProperties is reported when optional content is used and disables evaluation as 8.11.4.2 requires; missing required registry or configuration is repaired by disabling it, and valid unregistered OCGs retain initial ON state.

requirements.rule: InkList paths contain coordinate pairs in default user space. Reader policy joins samples with straight segments, butt caps and miter joins in one stroke, applying C, CA and BS width/dash. All paths validate before painting or returning an empty mark; indirect paths/coordinates resolve. Aggregate segment and temporary-storage bounds charge repeated indirect paths, and generated content has independent byte limits. Stored appearances retain precedence and the annotation rectangle clips the generated appearance. A present PDF 2.0 Path supplies bounded moveto/lineto/cubic geometry and ignores InkList without resolving, validating or allocating it, as clarified by Table 185 errata. Null Path falls back to the bounded InkList reader. Appearance generation does not establish required-key document conformance.

requirements.rule: Polygon closes its geometry and fills IC with the nonzero rule; PolyLine leaves endpoints open and IC applies only to line endings. Vertices are finite coordinate pairs in default user space. A present Path overrides Vertices and begins with one moveto pair, followed by lineto pairs or six cubic operands. Arrays and coordinates resolve indirectly. BS width/dash, C, CA and independent ca apply under the original annotation rectangle. Null/plain polygon border effects and standard polyline endings are supported through content-line-endings. Temporary storage, segment counts and emitted content are bounded before painting. Table 181 errata clarifies that Vertices is ignored when Path is present; appearance generation does not establish required-key document conformance.

requirements.rule: Line and PolyLine LE resolves two names with None defaults. All ten standard styles are recognized. requirements.rule: When LL is present, L identifies the source leader endpoints. The line proper is displaced perpendicular to L by abs(LL)+LLO; the sign of LL selects the side. Leader strokes start LLO from the source endpoints and extend LLE beyond the line proper. LLE requires LL; LLE and LLO are nonnegative, and all coordinates and arithmetic must remain finite. Without LL, L remains the line proper and LLO has no leader to offset. Reader policy uses +x for directionless L, the positive side for zero LL, one shared stroke for the body and leaders with the BS dash pattern, and ending marks anchored to the translated line. Fixed stack geometry and bounded content retain the original annotation clip.
requirements.status: implemented with 27 authored controls and 21 independent pixel expectations; hosted validation pending
requirements.gaps: Plain captions are covered by content-line-captions. Independent leader regions are literal rectangles with exact union coverage; broader diagonal interactions still need evidence.

requirements.rule: Cap true paints a plain Contents caption; false/absent ignores caption-only entries. Contents uses the common PDF text-string decoder and reported recovery. CP selects Inline or Top and CO supplies two finite offsets in the line frame. Reader layout policy uses 12-point Helvetica/WinAnsi, 1.2-em leading, two units of clearance, centred rows and the source line direction. CR, LF and CRLF separate rows; tabs become spaces. Inline text interrupts the line where its metric box overlaps it; overlong text moves above the line. Leader-translated geometry and standard endings retain their positions. Caption text uses C and ca (else CA) after body and endings under the original annotation clip. Font encoding is shared with form appearances; host-supplied fonts are explicit and generated resources are private. Text storage, characters, work, numeric positions and output remain bounded.
requirements.status: plain captions implemented with 30 authored controls and 22 independent pixel expectations; hosted validation pending
requirements.gaps: Rich text, complex-script/bidi shaping, broader font selection and characters outside the reversible WinAnsi map remain explicit gaps. Exact pixel controls independently read AFM advances and straight contours from the pinned Arimo substitute; they establish the documented reader policy, not identical competitor artwork.

requirements.rule: Generate Highlight, Underline, StrikeOut and Squiggly from finite, convex counterclockwise QuadPoints, resolving indirect arrays and numbers. The first edge defines the text direction. Reader artwork policy fills Highlight quads with Multiply, uses a bottom 1/12-height underline, a centred 1/12-height strikeout and a 1/24-height zigzag ribbon with alternating peaks 1/12 apart and horizontal steps at most height/6. All quads share one nonzero fill, so their overlap does not reapply opacity. C and ca (else CA) style the generated marks under the original annotation BBox. Absent C defaults to yellow for Highlight and black for the other subtypes. Geometry, work, temporary storage and content remain bounded before empty-color suppression. Stored appearances retain precedence. Top-left/top-right/bottom-left/bottom-right QuadPoints are reordered only under reported annotation.quad-order recovery; Strict rendering refuses that repair.
requirements.status: implemented with 41 authored controls and 33 independent pixel expectations; hosted validation pending
requirements.gaps: Exact artwork dimensions are reader policy. Broader malformed-quad compatibility and competitor comparison of this new subset still require evidence. Strict-open fixture metadata only describes opening; a separate unit check establishes Strict rendering refusal of alternate quad order.

requirements.rule: Caret normal appearance synthesis supports Sy None (including absent/null) and P with indirect values. Reader artwork is an original filled chevron and optional geometric pilcrow, scaled from a 16-unit grid to RD-inset bounds; both use a single nonzero fill with C (black default) and ca (else CA). No fonts are required. RD follows left/top/right/bottom order, requires four nonnegative finite values and positive remaining width/height, and preserves the original appearance BBox. The shared Square/Circle/Caret reader checks cardinality before resolving into fixed stack numbers and rejects extent/sum overflow. Geometry/work and output are bounded before empty-color suppression. Unrecognized symbols refuse explicitly; stored appearances retain precedence.
requirements.status: implemented with 31 authored controls and 21 independent pixel expectations; hosted validation pending
requirements.gaps: Exact chevron/pilcrow geometry and placement are documented reader artwork, not standardized pixels. Competitor comparison of this new subset remains pending.
